subject: Welcome to Google Voice
body:
Welcome Business Development,

Evrnew has given you your own Google Voice number. Use it to connect with  
others by voice or text, on your phone or any other device. Your new number  
is
(206) 453-0208

To get started, get the latest Google Voice app to activate your account.

  - Android:  
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.googlevoice

  - iPhone: https://itunes.apple.com/app/google-voice/id318698524?mt=8

  - Web: https://voice.google.com

After activating Google Voice, you can
1) Configure your account and link your personal phone or customize your  
voicemail greeting.

2) Try calling and texting from your new number. Your calls will be billed  
to your company.Go to this link to learn more.
https://support.google.com/voice#topic=1707989

3) Get support anytime by finding answers to your questions in the Google  
Voice Help Center.Go to this link to get help.
https://support.google.com/voice#topic=1707989

- The Google Voice team
